sources.title: Microduck - ROBOTS: Your Guide to the World of Robotics
sources.snippet: Microduck is a small biped robot with a distinctly ducklike waddle. Using AI skills, it can walk, sit, roller-skate, pick up objects with its beak, recover from falls, and quack in its own voice. Designed for developers, researchers, and robotics enthusiasts, it ships assembled, uses open-source software tools, and offers a playful platform for training, testing, and sharing new behaviors.

sources.title: Buy Microduck: Small robot. Super smart.
sources.snippet: Buy Microduck, the 10 inch bipedal AI robot by Pollen Robotics × Hugging Face, shown by Jensen Huang at NVIDIA GTC Berlin. Official preorders from $399.

sources.title: Meet Microduck | Pollen Robotics
sources.snippet: It sees, listens, speaks, and uses its head and body to communicate. Voice is its primary medium, making it an excellent platform for developing conversational AI, experimenting with vision models, and building expressive human-robot interactions. Microduck starts from the other side of physical AI: action. How do you teach a robot to move?
